candidate_architecture.description: Incremental regularized correction on frozen V1. Candidate tests whether strategy differentials explain V1's residual (actual_margin - v1_margin). It is NOT a standalone team-strength model: with frozen V1 as the base and only 3 regularized differential features, it cannot become an unconstrained margin predictor.
candidate_architecture.features_standardized: z-scored using training-fold mean/std before ridge fit

data.feature_source: nflverse/nflfastR PBP parquet in data/pbp_2021.parquet, data/pbp_2022.parquet (already in repo; 2020 PBP not needed: offseason reset means features for 2021 use only 2021 prior weeks)
data.game_spine: data/experiments/games_features.parquet (game_id, season, week, away_team, home_team, market_spread, v1_margin, actual_margin)
leakage_controls: strategy features use only plays from games with (season == S, week < W) for a prediction game in week W
no outcome columns (actual_margin, market_spread, epa of the predicted game) enter features
residual target uses frozen V1 predictions; cross-fitting keeps the strategy layer out-of-sample
season-based folds: no game appears in both train and test of a fold
data.line_provenance_note: Historical market_spread is the unverified single-snapshot nflverse line (Exp 004). It is a coarse benchmark, not a timestamped tradable baseline.

experimental_discipline.vault: 2023-2025 LOCKED; evaluate only if every gate passes, then STOP for human review

feature_construction.aggregation: season-to-date pooled mean over all qualifying plays from the team's completed games with week < W (weekly batching, consistent with V1)
feature_construction.differentials: home_value - away_value for each of the 3 features

early_down_pass_rate.definition: pass plays / (pass + run plays) on 1st and 2nd down
exclusions: qb_kneel and qb_spike are separate play_type values and excluded by the play_type filter
no score / win-probability filter (locked simple definition)
early_down_pass_rate.play_filter: posteam == team, down in (1,2), play_type in ('pass','run')

feature_construction.missing_value_treatment: if a team has fewer than 2 completed games before week W, its feature value is treated as league average, i.e. the differential is set to 0
feature_construction.offseason_treatment: hard reset each season; no cross-season carryover

pace_sec_per_play.definition: mean seconds elapsed between a team's consecutive offensive plays
pace_sec_per_play.exclusions: diffs <= 0 or > 40 seconds (removes timeouts, quarter breaks, possession changes, halftime)
pace_sec_per_play.note: higher value = slower pace; the differential sign is learned by the ridge, no sign assumption preregistered
pace_sec_per_play.procedure: sort team's plays by play_id within game; diff game_seconds_remaining to the next play (positive = time elapsed); keep diffs in (0, 40]

proe.definition: mean pass_oe over the team's offensive plays
proe.note: pass_oe is the nflfastR per-play pass-rate-over-expected; ~80% null on 4th down in this data, so restricted to downs 1-3
proe.play_filter: posteam == team, down in (1,2,3), pass_oe not null

feature_construction.weighting: equal weight per qualifying play (pooled mean)

C.criterion: in EACH of 2021 and 2022 separately: candidate MAE < V1 MAE AND candidate MAE <= market MAE - 0.15

D.criterion: candidate calibration slope (OLS slope of actual_margin on predicted margin) within [0.8, 1.2]

F.criterion: (i) all 3 feature coefficient signs identical across the two folds; (ii) each leave-one-feature-out ablation (refit 2-feature ridge, same procedure) still beats V1 overall MAE, i.e. no single feature drives the result

gates.rule: ALL must pass. No relaxing after results. Any failure closes the experiment null.

metrics.calibration_slope: OLS slope of actual_margin regressed on predicted margin

training_procedure.rationale: Frozen V1 predictions exist only for 2021+ (2018-2020 spine rows have null v1_margin), so 2018-2020 cannot supply the residual target. Same constraint and remedy as Experiment 005, preregistered here upfront rather than amended. Strategy features remain strictly pre-game in both folds.
